description: Fetch one message by ID from a channel or thread, with its author, content, attachments, embeds, reactions and poll. Use it when you already have the message ID; to read recent history use discord_list_messages, and to find messages by text use discord_search_guild_messages. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel, Read Message History. Read-only; safe to retry.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel or thread that holds the message
